Ram Temple Donation Theft Allegations Spark Political Debate and Investigation

Allegations of theft of donations at the Ayodhya Ram temple have led to a political row, with opposition leaders seeking accountability from the Prime Minister. Investigations are underway, with police questioning individuals and seeking missing CCTV footage. The matter has also reached the Supreme Court, with a status report filed by a Special Investigation Team.
